name: Amber Smith
occupation: Niobrara County clerk of district court-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Amber Smith is the Niobrara County clerk of district court-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Chrisanna Lund, who is serving through the current term. The official 2026 general election summary lists her with 881 votes.
